value.rationale: Counting distinct minimum PMU placements is a natural robustness/flexibility statistic for power-domination optimization. The all-order modulo-three count and sharp exceptional size n=4 are not implied by the known extremal cardinality. The proof resolves a motivated lowest-degree coefficient for the one-leaf cycle corona within the explicitly recognized harder one-leaf-corona polynomial problem, with an actionable gap-based classification. The claim is deliberately not the full polynomial.
